entities.name: Gabriela Babnik Ouattara
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gabriela Babnik is a Slovene writer, literary critic and translator. She has published three novels and her journalistic literary and film criticism regularly appears in national newspapers and magazines in Slovenia.
